formattedAddress: 108, Taiwan, Taipei City, Wanhua District, Rende Village, Lane 257, Kunming St, 14號1樓

text.text: The food here is truly impressive! 💯 I ordered the pesto pasta with crispy chicken – beautifully presented, flavorful, and the portion was very generous. The staff were super friendly and helpful. The space is also really cute, modern, and chill – perfect for hanging out with friends or a casual date. I’ll definitely come back to try more dishes! 💚🍝☕️

text.text:
Small restaurant with only 6 tables, max capacity 18 pax. Environment is decorated with many wood furniture, chill vibes. Chanced upon it during the rain and the quality of food is better than expected.

Ordered vegetarian pesto and their chef suggestion Chicken cutlet with cream spaghetti. Both spaghetti is soft type and standard veggies (broccoli, baby corn and mushroom). The taste is mild but overall good. Chicken cutlet is crispy and juicy. 👍 The mushroom soup taste like premade pack. Onion rings were really crispy and ketchup is good. Their tea is really good but it's quite sweet. The foam with alpaca spoon is really cute. Total TWD 790 for 2 pax.

A little expensive and a little deserted.

text.text: Found this because of its great reviews and it didnt disappoint. Service was impeccable and they gave me 4 extra bread just because one end of a bread was slightly soggy from the extremely juicy steak 😭😭😭. Food was very filling and scrumptious. Atmosphere was very chill and cozy. 100% recommend!
